privateFiles.otherPlatforms: Use an application vault with explicit intent export/import; HTTP SDK remains portable.

android.dependencyPolicy: Exclude okhttp-jvm and JNA; select OkHttp5.5.1 Android variant and application private storage.

verificationPolicy: Installed consumer and production acceptance is recorded separately; compilation does not establish Android device acceptance.
verificationScope: Supported runtimes are compatibility targets. Listed tested toolchains describe finite native checks; installed-consumer, service, mobile and distribution evidence is recorded separately in dated release notes. Source presence does not establish registry availability.
